items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I said, I'm going to give Jerry the Brothers a hand. He gave me $12 a day to work for me.

ctx.x: Oh, I thought that was right.

I gave it up. Went back to my trade. In 1919. I scanned mail in 1919. I gave it up. So, I gave 18 months carrying mail and I gave it up. Went back to my trade, which I was doing. So, I was in the post office making 3,020 cents a day. I just raised our salary to $6 a day. You understand? So, I went back to my trade. So, the knife supervisor, Mr. Fogarty, I was in the post office making 3,020 cents a day. I just raised our salary to $6 a day. You understand? So, I went back to my trade. So, the knife supervisor,…
Well, you still have the house up there on Fairmont.
